verdict.rationale: Heap's homepage names an in-product AI feature, Sense Chat, that lets users skip onboarding and 'go straight to insights'. That is first-party evidence for AI-driven insights inside the product. But it is one marketing sentence, with no documentation of how insights or suggestions are generated from the user's data. Missing for 10: documentation of Sense Chat's capabilities, evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions, details on what data it analyzes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Sense Chat makes it easy for anyone to get started with analytics, no matter their experience. Skip the learning curve and lengthy onboarding—and go straight to insights.
